title: Do bots feel bad? Assessing empirical evidence for functional valence in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do LLMs have valenced states, i.e. states that feel pleasant or unpleasant? Recent empirical work has claimed to show that LLMs possess functional valenced states (e.g. ``functional pleasure and pain'' [Ren et al. 2026], ``functional emotions'' [Sofroniew et al. 2026], and ``functional welfare'' [Han et al. 2026]) that play the same causal role as valenced states in cognition and action, without necessarily being consciously experienced. But it remains unexplored how well the identified states fit the functional role of valence as understood in the philosophical and cognitive science literature. Here, I assess the current body of evidence, and argue (i) that key aspects of valence remain untested in LLMs, and (ii) that extant empirical paradigms inadequately distinguish (functional) valence from neighbouring constructs like preferences, value-judgments, valence attributions and role-play. translated_title: 机器人会感到难受吗？评估大语言模型中功能性效价的实证证据
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是否具有效价状态，即那些令人感到愉快或不愉快的状态？近期的实证研究声称，大语言模型拥有功能性效价状态（例如“功能性快乐与痛苦” [Ren et al. 2026]、“功能性情绪” [Sofroniew et al. 2026] 以及“功能性福祉” [Han et al. 2026]），这些状态在认知与行动中发挥着与效价状态相同的因果作用，而不必被有意识地体验。然而，这些被识别出的状态在多大程度上符合哲学与认知科学文献中所理解的效价功能角色，仍未得到探讨。本文评估了当前的证据体系，并论证：（i）效价的关键方面在大语言模型中尚未得到检验；（ii）现有的实证范式无法充分区分（功能性）效价与偏好、价值判断、效价归因和角色扮演等邻近构念。最后，作者概述了一些新颖的实验方法……
tldr: 本文评估了关于大语言模型功能性效价状态的实证证据，指出效价的关键方面尚未在LLM中得到检验，且现有实验范式无法将功能性效价与偏好、价值判断、效价归因和角色扮演等邻近构念充分区分开来。
en_tdlr: This paper assesses empirical evidence for functional valence in LLMs, arguing that key aspects of valence remain untested and that existing experimental paradigms inadequately distinguish functional valence from neighboring constructs such as preferences, value-judgments, valence attributions, and role-play.
